meta.title: Ha Giang Loop | The Only Tour You NEED To Do In Vietnam
meta.description:
Hannah and I both did this tour a year apart. Hannah loved it so much she signed me up for it without any explanation except "it's the best thing I did last year." I went into this tour not expecting much but it blew me away day after day. We think the region will get more developed overtime as tourism increases so get there while it still feels like a secret pocket of Vietnam with no resort hotels. 
-Guus

comments.text:
Hi Guus,

I run Hóng 30s, a small Vietnamese Facebook/YouTube channel that shares stories of foreign travelers discovering Vietnam. I really loved your video “Ha Giang Loop | The Only Tour You NEED To Do In Vietnam”. The way you captured the mountain passes, the Nho Quế river and the rice terraces made many Vietnamese viewers proud of their homeland.

I would like to ask your permission to use some clips from that video:

A short vertical video (about 50 seconds) with Vietnamese narration describing the beauty of Hà Giang.
A longer video (about 8–10 minutes) retelling your 4-day journey in Vietnamese, using your footage with your voice softly in the background.

Your channel name will appear on screen during the whole video (“VIDEO: TRAVELS FROM YESTERDAY”), and the description will include your name and a link to your original video, so Vietnamese viewers can find and subscribe to your channel. We will not cut out your message or change what you said, and we won’t add any ads or sponsors related to your video.

If you agree, a short reply is enough. If you’d prefer that we don’t use it, or you’d like any changes (for example a different credit line), just let me know and I’ll follow your wishes.

Thank you for showing Vietnam so beautifully
